protocol.task: damage-aware parallel-jaw squeeze: two rigid sticky plates close on the object along its narrower horizontal axis by d*W/2 each over 1.0 s, hold until 1.5 s, open (plates removed), free relaxation until 4.0 s; gravity, floor collider; same MPM settings as V2 main/C1 (low damping, substep 1e-4, n_grid from template).
protocol.decision: largest candidate depth d whose predicted permanent crush <= tau and d >= d_min; else abstain (refuse grasp)
protocol.damage_metric_definition: PRIMARY. permanent crush = (span_ref - span_sq_aligned) / W: span = 1-99 % quantile extent along the squeeze axis of all MPM particles averaged over 3.5-4.0 s (after release); the squeezed configuration is first rigidly (Procrustes) aligned to the reference (d=0 run, same parameters), so rigid rotation after release is not counted; W = initial width along the squeeze axis (narrower horizontal axis)
protocol.gravity: off for the task (g=0): under the V2-main gravity setting most elastoplastic objects slump to a puddle in <0.5 s (pilot figure docs/v3e/figs/pilot_particles_gravity.png), which makes a grasp ill-posed
protocol.execution: GT-parameter simulation at the chosen depth (shared GT runs at every candidate depth; Warp-MPM run-to-run nondeterminism noted separately)
protocol.success: chosen d is GT-feasible, or abstain when no candidate depth is GT-feasible
protocol.utility: secondary (added after the primary-metric switch, before final results): achieved safe grasp depth = d_chosen if GT-feasible else 0 (damage or abstain); oracle utility = d_oracle
protocol.twins: object geometry = observed object for every method; twins differ only in material law/parameters; hardening/softening are not predicted (0.25 for twins, GT values for GT)
protocol.fixed_heuristic: single depth or abstain for all objects, chosen leave-one-out on the other evaluated samples using their GT outcomes
protocol.bootstrap: object (cluster) bootstrap over object identities, 2000 resamples, percentile 95% CI
